title: test: maxChanges=0 test missing liveness follow-up assertion
description: test_contact_changes_max_changes_zero_does_not_regress_state only checks that newState does not regress (newState == sinceState when maxChanges=0 and changes are pending). It does not include a follow-up call with maxChanges>0 using the returned newState to verify that the pending change is actually deliverable (liveness property). A future change that breaks the paging-from-zero path would not be caught by this test. The existing test_contact_changes_newstate_correct_after_truncation covers maxChanges=1 paging but does not exercise the maxChanges=0 → maxChanges=1 sequence specifically. Add a follow-up call inside the existing test: after asserting newState==sinceState, call Contact/changes with sinceState=newState and maxChanges=1 and assert uid-r2 appears in created.
